commit_sha_note: Null by construction: this receipt is committed INSIDE the commit it describes, so it cannot contain that commit's own hash. There is no queue field to carry the sha because this opening is deliberately not modelled as a queue task (see not_a_queue_archive). The commit is identified by its parent, its declared path set, and the per-path hashes recorded here.
path_sha256_note: The receipt's own hash is necessarily absent from this map, for the same reason commit_sha is null. The other four are pre-commit working-tree hashes and are verifiable against the committed blobs.

goal_layout.reason: New goal opened directly in the sharded layout rather than as a flat GOAL-MCE-001.yaml. not_a_queue_archive.reason: tools/research_dispatch.py requires archive.source_task_ids to be nonempty and forbids an archive claiming another archive, so an opening snapshot with no producer task to claim is not expressible as a queue archive. Modelling it as one and amending it afterwards is what GOAL-HAWK-001 BATCH-001 had to do. This batch follows GOAL-HQC-001 BATCH-001 in not modelling it as a queue task at all.
not_a_queue_archive.consequence: This receipt is NOT verified by the dispatcher. It is an auditable record of what the opening commit changed, checkable by hand against git diff-tree.
not_a_queue_archive.queue_ownership: dispatch_queue.json is committed here at its BATCH-001-opening state and is thereafter owned by the ledger archive TASK-20260803-a561d8, which commits its terminal state. It is deliberately NOT in the snapshot archive TASK-20260803-f3beb0's declared paths, so that snapshot must be staged by exact pathspec rather than git add -A.
